name: Cleanskin — The Unmodified Body Movement
creator: Emerged from multiple simultaneous community sources, Tier 3, approximately 2195
description: A fashion and identity movement celebrating the completely unmodified human body — no chrome, no geneware, no subdermal implants, no cosmetic synthesis treatments — as a deliberate aesthetic and philosophical statement. Cleanskin practitioners dress to emphasize natural body lines, unpigmented skin, unaugmented movement, and the visible evidence of biological aging. The movement contains a genuinely contested ideological spectrum ranging from anti-corporate bodily autonomy advocates to, at its troubling fringe, groups with eugenic undertones that the mainstream movement works actively to disavow.
cultural_impact: Cleanskin forced a necessary public conversation about whether the pressure to augment constitutes coercion, particularly in corporate employment contexts where unaugmented workers face systemic disadvantage. The movement's fashion dimension — dressing to make the unmodified body visible and celebrated — became a distinct aesthetic language recognized across all tiers.
controversy: The movement's internal struggle with its eugenic fringe is ongoing and unresolved. Several Cleanskin community spaces have been accused of harboring implicit anti-geneware bigotry that targets practitioners with heritable modifications or medical-necessity augmentation. The mainstream movement's attempts to police this boundary have been only partially successful.
story_hooks: A prominent Cleanskin community leader is revealed to have a concealed medical augmentation they've kept secret for years — the fallout splits the movement between those who see betrayal and those who see the proof of their own coercive culture.
A Cleanskin fashion showcase is disrupted by protesters who have documented the event's financial backing by a corponation with interests in suppressing augmentation worker protections.

A young person raised in a strict Cleanskin household begins secretly exploring augmentation — their journey exposes both the genuine values and the hidden coercions of the community that raised them.
